best_section.where: past the yellow ring, alongside the rail-embankment trees, opposite the two-storey grey-roofed house

drivers.road: Quiet residential cul-de-sac-style street running beside the rail corridor, not a through route.
drivers.room_and_convention: A car is already parked kerbside near this stretch, showing parking here is normal; no driveway or crossing crosses the yellow line itself.
drivers.houses: Houses sit across the road, roughly 10-15m from the kerb at the southern end of the section — closer than ideal but separated by the carriageway.

flags: Runs beside a railway line: trains may cause noise
Grade hits about 7% in short stretches elsewhere on this kerb (best section itself is flatter, ~2%)
sun_shade: Tree canopy from the rail-embankment side (north) overhangs most of the best section, giving shade for much of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether a driveway crossover interrupts the flat stretch near the houses
summary: Quiet street by the rail line with an established parking spot, but houses sit fairly close across the road.
reasons: Quiet residential street, not a through route
Car already parked shows kerbside parking is normal
Houses across road within ~10-15m at section's end
